meta.name: Product design tokens

referenceViewport.unit: ru (reference unit; 1 ru = 1 logical pt at the canonical viewport)

meta.format: Every leaf is { value, confidence, evidence?, notes? }. Strings like "{color.primary}" are aliases. Components must reference tokens by path, never by raw value. Exceptions: typography entries are composite ({ size, lineHeight, weight, ... }); score.thresholds and flowLetter gradients hold structured values; keys starting with "_" are comments.

confidenceLevels.VERIFIED: Measured in an ACTIVE-window capture at canonical 788x1083, flat fill / repeated measurement, encoding-converged. Safe to hard-require.
confidenceLevels.SUPPORTED: Measured but converted between colour encodings, seen on a single canonical screen, or consistent across several screens at lower precision. Safe default; may be tuned by a deliberate design change.
confidenceLevels.CANDIDATE: Seen only in inactive-window or alternate-viewport captures, or only as a qualitative colour/role. Use as a placeholder; do not treat as fact.
confidenceLevels.ESTIMATED: Fitted, derived or chosen by the design system (not measured). A recommended default.

rules: Evidence ids (S0xx) point at state ids in UI_MAPPING.md.
Colours were normalised to sRGB. Original captures used three encodings; raw hex from non-sRGB files is not canonical.
No value derived from an inactive-window colour is marked VERIFIED or SUPPORTED.
No value derived from the 554x772 captures is used as a canonical size.
Motion is intentionally absent: no motion timing was measured (see DESIGN_DECISIONS DD-10).
Naming: "...Text" = text on neutral surfaces; "...TextOnTint" = text on that hue's tint; "...Strong" = filled control carrying body-size white text.

Colour profiles: see meta.colorProfile. Default = production. Fidelity is an explicit opt-in; switching is done by applying meta.colorProfile.fidelityOverrides, never by editing component code or deleting a fidelity token.
contrastNotes: White on color.primary 3.7:1 and on feature.writing.answerCard 4.0:1: large/bold text only. Body-size white text must sit on primaryStrong (5.2:1) or a computed-contrast fallback.
color.error on white 3.8:1 and color.success on white 2.5:1 fail for body-size text: use errorText / successText.
color.warning on white 2.8:1 (fails text and 3:1 outline): use warningText (5.2:1).
color.primary on primaryTint 3.0:1 (fails): use primaryTextOnTint (5.5:1). color.error on errorTint 3.3:1 and errorText on errorTint 4.1-4.2:1 (fail): use errorTextOnTint (>= 5.5:1).
color.success on successTint 2.1:1 (diff added word): use successText (4.6:1).

textPrimary on feature.writing.answerCard 4.8:1, on feature.grammar.answerCard 4.7:1, on color.primary 5.2:1, on feature.grammar.homeCardFill about 4.6:1, and on feature.conversation.homeCardFill about 11.6:1: pass. Answer cards use answerPalette.*.foreground; the home cards use accessible.onFeatureFill (ACCESSIBILITY 8A).
control_state.toggleOff 2.0:1 on white (state indicator, needs 3:1): use toggleOffStrong.
meta.qa: 2026-10-09 final implementation-readiness QA + approved v1 decisions (DD-22..DD-26 APPROVED_V1): meta.colorProfile, answerPalette pairs, accessible.onBrand invariant. No observed value was changed.

colorProfile.production: DEFAULT. Resolve every accessible.* token to the value written in this file. Use accessible.* wherever a colour carries text, an icon, an outline or a state indicator and contrast requires it (ACCESSIBILITY 8A).
colorProfile.fidelity: EXPLICIT OPT-IN ONLY, by the product owner, recorded in DESIGN_DECISIONS DD-22. Resolve each accessible.* key listed in fidelityOverrides to its mapped fidelity token instead. Expect WCAG AA failures on body-size text. A coding agent never enables it on its own.
colorProfile.alwaysFidelity: Raw color.*, feedback.*, score.*, grade.* tokens stay available in BOTH profiles for decorative fills, dots, bars, previews and swatch thumbnails.
colorProfile.invariant: answerPalette.* pairs, control_state.action*, and every token not listed in fidelityOverrides are identical in both profiles.

backgroundPlain.notes: Pure-white page used by data/list/chat/settings screens. Choose per template (SCREEN_TEMPLATES).

surfaceElevated.notes: Same fill as surface; elevation is expressed by shadow.floating plus (sometimes) scrim, never by a different fill.

surfaceMuted.notes: Correction panel, score chip, recap box, preview panels, scripted-AI bubble (candidate). Downgraded: measured on a score chip and a correction panel; one source capture was inactive-window.

textPrimary.notes: Measured as darkest glyph pixel; true colour may be equal or darker.

textSecondary.notes: Subtitles, descriptions. Contrast vs background about 7:1.

textMuted.notes: Captions, glosses, role labels. Chosen over the lighter measured caption (#737985) because it passes 4.5:1 on background; measured glyph pixels are lower bounds on darkness.

textFaint.notes: Decorative only: faded index numerals, placeholder, disabled. Fails 4.5:1; never for essential text.

textOnPrimary.notes: White text on primary/indigo fills. Not valid on success, lime or glass fills (contrast).

border.notes: Hairline borders, dividers, idle progress segments, empty dot-matrix cells.

default.notes: Page #F9FAFB measured to #CACACA (about 19% black) behind the exit dialog and #C4C5C6 (about 21%) behind the FAB menu and info sheet. Surface-specific: several floating surfaces have NO scrim (feedback, popover, create sheet, paywall).

strong.notes: Tutorial overlay only; source capture was an inactive window.

primary.notes: Same colour read as #3B82F6 (sRGB) and #4E80EE (P3). Banner, deck header, default input, scenario progress.

primaryTint.notes: Selected quick chip, soft badge background.

success.notes: sRGB-normalised from raw #2CB782. Toggles on, selected radio, check, correct verdict.

successTint.notes: Added-word chip in the correction diff; measured from an inactive-window capture.

warning.notes: Nearest clean value to measured orange (#FA6600 untagged, about #FB720E normalised): selected filter chip outline, streak value, mid score, 'mistake' bullets.

error.notes: Identical in untagged and normalised captures. Incorrect verdict, removed words, low score dot, destructive text. Downgraded: the red sample came from an inactive-window capture; identical after encoding normalisation.

errorTint.notes: Destructive action pill background; observed qualitatively as 'pale red', not measured.

primaryStrong.notes: Same hue family as the measured indigo accent. Use for text-on-fill and filled controls that carry body-size white text: white on it is 5.2:1. White on color.primary is only 3.7:1 (large text only). NOTE: identical hex to the measured conversation indigo, which is why feature.conversation.* alias it. Confidence SUPPORTED comes from that coincidence; its role as the accessible-production blue is a design-system choice.

errorText.notes: Chosen for 4.8:1 on white. Use for error TEXT at body size; color.error (3.8:1 on white) is for icons, fills, dots and large text.

successText.notes: Chosen for 5.5:1 on white. Use for success TEXT at body size; color.success (2.5:1 on white) is for fills, icons and dots only.

warningText.notes: Production alternative to color.warning for text and 3:1 outlines. 5.2:1 on white, 4.7:1 on surfaceMuted. Fill/dots/icons next to text keep color.warning.

primaryTextOnTint.notes: Production text/icon colour on primaryTint or feature.srs.posBadgeBg. 5.5:1 on #DBEAFE. color.primary on those tints is only 3.0:1.

errorTextOnTint.notes: Production text colour on errorTint (e.g. destructive dialog action). 5.9:1 on errorTint over white. errorText there is only 4.1-4.2:1.

feature._note: Per-mode identity. Roles: accent (hero punctuation, links, selected state), cta (primary lesson button fill), answerCard (editor input card default), progress (completed ProgressStepper segments). Feature identity is intentionally light: the neutral system dominates.

accent.notes: Hero period and Home card are blue.

answerCard.notes: Purple; user-configurable colour setting, so this is the DEFAULT. Downgraded: original sample from an inactive capture, converged with the active capture after encoding conversion.

homeCardFill.notes: Card 01 measured blue (raw P3 #3A81F5, normalised #0883FD) with a different fill from the generic primary; unify to primary unless a design change decides otherwise.

progressCurrent.notes: Current segment of ProgressStepper (PATTERNS P10: current = tint). Tint alone is close to color.border, so the current segment MUST also carry a non-colour cue: a 2 focus-ring-width outline in the mode progress colour. Not measured.

accent.notes: Lime: hero period, carousel active dot, tip bullets. Never use lime as text on light surfaces.

cta.notes: CTA label colour is not evidenced; use textPrimary on lime (contrast).

answerCard.notes: Active capture S058 confirms the card is BLUE; exact hex only seen in an inactive capture.

homeCardFill.notes: Active Grammar mode card sampled near #8A5BF7 in a flat area of the live app screenshot. Production fill is shifted slightly brighter to give textPrimary at least 4.5:1 contrast; JPEG colour may differ slightly from source assets.

progressCurrent.notes: Current segment of ProgressStepper (PATTERNS P10: current = tint). Tint alone is close to color.border, so the current segment MUST also carry a non-colour cue: a 2 focus-ring-width outline in the mode progress colour. Not measured.

accent.notes: sRGB-normalised from raw #475DE8. User bubble, send button, CTA, active pager dot. Alias of color.primaryStrong (same hex #2563EB, one concept).

cta.notes: Alias of color.primaryStrong (same hex #2563EB, one concept).

userBubble.notes: Alias of color.primaryStrong (same hex #2563EB, one concept).

homeCardFill.notes: Conversation mode card cyan sampled from a flat peek area of the live app screenshot; JPEG colour may differ slightly from source assets.

aiBubble.notes: Grey-filled (free chat uses white with hairline). Hex not measured.

progress.notes: Completed segments solid blue; current light blue ({color.primaryTint}).

flowLetter._note: A separate visual world: full-bleed gradient backgrounds and glass controls. Gradient stops are three point samples in the capture's native encoding (not sRGB-normalised) so they are CANDIDATE.

round.notes: Nature topic. Background hue varies per topic/source.

roundDeck.notes: Deck-source round observed as purple; hex unmeasured. Aliased to the purple options gradient so the value resolves (was the bare word "purple").

glassFill.notes: Observed as translucent white; alpha chosen.

promptEntryFill.notes: PromptEntry pill fill; outline via shadow.hairline. DD-23.

home._note: Home-surface defaults chosen by the design system (DD-23).

partial.notes: Blue thumbs-up verdict for 'close'; hex not measured.

removedText.notes: Always with strike-through so colour is not the only cue.

improvement.notes: Purple bullets: 'key improvements' (writing) and 'areas to improve' (conversation).

score._note: Conversation score bands. Only 58 (red) and 84-88 (orange) were observed. Thresholds and the top band are unobserved: DESIGN_DECISIONS DD-11.

mid.notes: Observed at 84, 86 and 88 (chip dot and sheet number).

cefr._note: Level scale left-bar colours. Raw values from a profile-tagged capture, not normalised.

submitDisabled.notes: Ring colour of the disabled circular submit.

toggleOffStrong.notes: Production off-track for Toggle (state indicator needs 3:1 against the surface). 3.3:1 on white. control_state.toggleOff is the fidelity value.

actionFill.notes: Fill of Button/Primary (the neutral dark action: FeedbackActionRow primary, Dialog neutral-primary, settings CTA, Sheet/Create CTA). Same navy as the writing lesson CTA, aliased once so non-writing screens do not reference a mode token.

secondaryFill.notes: Fill of Button/Secondary (Edit, Fix, Stay, Cancel). Label colour textPrimary (17:1).

sm.notes: Chip gaps, chip row gaps, prompt gaps, grid gap (measured 9, snapped to 8).

md.notes: Dashboard page margin, carousel item gap (12-13).

xl.notes: Section gaps measured 19-39 with no single value.

space._note: 4pt base grid. Do not invent in-between values.

control.notes: Chat bubbles, multi-line inputs, small rectangular controls. Buttons and chips use radius.full.

largeCard.notes: Lesson card, answer card, topic card, SRS card (fit 23-26, tolerance +/-1.5).

heroCard.notes: Dashboard mode card; one active measurement (rms 0.34-0.40).

sheet.notes: Fit 18.7-20.7 on top corners. Bottom corners unmeasured; all four rounded.

dialog.notes: Top corners fit 24 (rms 0.31). Bottom corners unmeasured. Downgraded: top corners only.

typography._note: Hierarchy ratios are SUPPORTED (frame heights from AX). 'size' and 'lineHeight' are the production values (ESTIMATED, chosen for legibility); 'ref' is the estimated size at the canonical viewport and is INFORMATIONAL ONLY: never use it in code. Live GramaGo app bundle identifies Plus Jakarta Sans (DD-08). Typography entries are composite (size, lineHeight, weight, optional letterSpacing/transform) and have no 'value' key. Floors: body 14, caption 12, microLabel 10 (microLabel only uppercase, short, never for sentences).

family.notes: Identified from the running GramaGo app bundle; the client uses the OFL release from Google Fonts (DD-08).

display.notes: Hero headline; tight leading; two-tone colouring.

heading.notes: Nav titles, section titles, verdict titles.

body.notes: Subtitles, descriptions, bubble text. Floor 14 (ref 11 is too small for product use).

displayCompact.notes: SectionHeader/Hero on compact (RESPONSIVE_RULES 11). No other type steps down.

hairline.notes: Lesson card and AI bubble borders; border width was not measured.

raised.notes: SRS card and stacked cards show a soft shadow.

floating.notes: Sheets/popovers: bottom edge about 25% black fading over about 48, sides over about 38.

menu.notes: Live Menu preserves a faint view of Home behind a blurred wash.

bar.notes: Floating bottom bar and frosted menu overlay. Blur strength unmeasured.

streakHero.notes: Large flame illustration on the streak summary.

control.notes: Icon inside a nav action or list control (measured 26-27).

tile.notes: Coloured round icon tile in menu rows.

icon._note: Use one outline icon family with consistent stroke. Do not mix families (DD-18).

minTouchTarget.notes: Platform accessibility floor. Visual size may be smaller than this; the hit area may not.

menuListAlignmentY.notes: Menu shortcuts sit below the vertical centre of the window.

homeDockHeight.notes: Home dock spans the full window width at the bottom; streak pill floats over its centre.

contentWidthDashboard.notes: Reference measurement at 788 only. DO NOT USE in code: derive from viewport - 2 x margin, capped by layout.contentMaxWidth.

contentMaxWidth.notes: Cap for windows wider than the reference; only 788 was observed (DD-12).

modeCardWidthRatio.notes: 670 of 788; the next card peeks. Active card is about 4% taller (385 vs 369).

sheetWidth.notes: Floating card, about 57% of the reference width. Rule form in RESPONSIVE_RULES.

sheetMaxHeightRatio.notes: Content measured about 458 of 1083 (42%); sheets are anchored low.

breakpointWide.notes: viewport > this = wide (centre a contentMaxWidth column).

stackActionsBelow.notes: Two-button action rows stack (primary on top) when the container is narrower than this.

hideBarCaptionsBelow.notes: FloatingBottomBar drops pill captions when contentWidth is below this.

stepperSegmentMinWidth.notes: Segments shrink to this before the count changes.

sheetMaxHeightRatioCompact.notes: Sheet max height as a ratio of viewport height on compact.

sheetMaxHeightRatioShort.notes: Sheet max height cap for landscape / short viewports (DD-12).

modeCardMinHeight.notes: ModeCard minimum height (observed 370-385); content-driven above this.

lessonCardWidthRatio.notes: LessonCard width = ratio x viewport (650/788); next card peeks. Replaces the "viewport - 2 x marginScreen - peek" formula.

srsCardWidthRatio.notes: SRSCard width = ratio x viewport, capped at contentMaxWidth; compact = contentWidth.

srsCardAspect.notes: SRSCard width / height (460 / 583). Height = width / aspect, then content may grow it.

answerCardMinHeight.notes: AnswerInput minimum height; it flexes to fill the remaining height (observed up to ~460).

feedbackCompactAlignmentY.notes: Vertical Alignment.y for compact correct feedback within the exercise workspace.

feedbackDetailedAlignmentY.notes: Vertical Alignment.y for detailed incorrect feedback within the exercise workspace.

letterTileSize.notes: LetterTile square size (observed 40-44); equals the minimum touch target.

popupMenuWidth.notes: PopupMenu width; grow to fit the longest label.

hintChipBlur.notes: Blur radius (ru) applied to an unrevealed hint chip label. Visual only; the accessible name never leaks the hint.

inlinePopoverOffset.notes: Gap between a PopupMenu and its trigger (space.xs).

_note.text: Accessible-production aliases. DEFAULT profile = production (ACCESSIBILITY 8A). Use accessible.* for TEXT, links, outlines that must be seen, state indicators and text-on-fill pairs. Use the raw color.* fidelity token for fills, dots, icons beside text, and decoration. Every entry is an alias, so no observed value is replaced.

link.notes: Link / blue text on white or surface. Fidelity: color.primary 3.7:1.

textOnPrimaryTint.notes: Text/icon on primaryTint, posBadgeBg, selected plan card. Fidelity: color.primary 3.0:1.

warningText.notes: Orange text (streak value, mid score number, mistake label) and filter-chip selected outline. Fidelity: color.warning 2.8:1.

errorText.notes: Red text on white/surface. Fidelity: color.error 3.8:1.

errorTextOnTint.notes: Red text on errorTint (destructive action label). errorText there is 4.1-4.2:1.

partialText.notes: FeedbackSheet partial verdict title text. Fidelity: feedback.partial (primary) 3.7:1.

diffAddedText.notes: CorrectionDiff added word on feedback.diff.addedBg. Fidelity feedback.diff.addedText is 2.1:1 on its tint.

scoreLowText.notes: Score number text. score.low is for the dot.

scoreMidText.notes: Score number text. score.mid is for the dot.

scoreHighText.notes: Score number text. score.high is for the dot.

heroSecondLine.notes: Second (faded) line of SectionHeader/Hero. Fidelity: color.textFaint 2.6:1 (fails even as large text).

focusRing.notes: Focus ring colour; 5.2:1 on white and visible on primary-filled controls because of the focus.ringOffset gap.

toggleOn.notes: Toggle on track (state indicator needs 3:1 on the surface). Fidelity: color.success is 2.5:1 on white.

selectedIndicator.notes: Selected radio / check in SelectableRow. Fidelity: color.success 2.5:1. Always paired with a check or filled radio shape.

brandFill.notes: Fill of every brand-blue SURFACE that carries body-size text: Banner/Feature, FlashcardDeckHeader, FAB/CTA fills (Banner/Promo and TopicCard/Plus only when paywallEnabled). Production value primaryStrong (white on it 5.2:1). The fidelity profile points it to color.primary (white on it 3.7:1).

onBrand.notes: Text/icon colour on accessible.brandFill and on feature.conversation.* fills (#2563EB). White in BOTH profiles; it is never flipped.

onFeatureFill.notes: Text colour on feature.writing.homeCardFill, feature.grammar.homeCardFill, feature.conversation.homeCardFill, and feature.scenario.taskBubble. textPrimary passes at least 4.5:1 on the home cards. Answer cards are NOT covered here: they use answerPalette.*.foreground. Fidelity: color.textOnPrimary.

onGradeFill.notes: Icon glyph colour inside SRSGradeButton circles. White on grade.hard is 2.2:1 and on grade.easy 2.1:1; textPrimary is 4.7-9.2:1 on all four.

ringOffset.notes: Gap between control edge and ring, so the ring sits on the page colour, not the control fill.

motion._note: Motion timing was never measured (DD-10). These are design-system defaults so agents do not hard-code durations. Reduced motion: replace slide/scale with a fade of motion.fast, disable carousel scale and shake.

fast.notes: ms. State changes: pressed, selected, toggle.

sheet.notes: ms. Sheet / dialog / popup enter and exit (200-250 range of DD-10).

sheetEnterOffset.notes: px. Feedback sheet enters from below and returns below on dismissal; reduced motion uses fade only.

feedbackMinimumDwell.notes: ms. Minimum visible duration for exercise grading feedback before a locally resolved verdict is shown. Cancel remains available.

carouselActiveScale.notes: Active ModeCard scale (about 4%). Disabled under reduced motion.

state._note: Generic interaction-state treatments. Apply to any component whose entry says "pressed" or "disabled" and gives no component-specific colour.

pressedOverlay.notes: Overlay painted over the pressed control (textPrimary at 8%). On dark or saturated fills use rgba(255,255,255,0.16) instead.

disabledOpacity.notes: Opacity of a disabled control and its label. WCAG exempts disabled controls from contrast; they must still be visible and in the tree. Controls with their own disabled colour (SubmitButton, ChatComposer send) use that colour at opacity 1.

modeCardIndexOpacity.notes: Decorative ModeCard index uses its paired foreground at the 24% opacity specified in COMPONENTS. Never use for actionable text.

modeCardDividerOpacity.notes: Decorative divider in ModeCard, applied to the paired foreground.

answerPalette._note: Answer-card colour choices (DD-26, APPROVED_V1). Every entry is a SAFE PAIR: use background and foreground together, always. Agents never pick or compute a foreground themselves. Foreground covers text, placeholder, caret and any icon drawn on the card. The pair is identical in the production and fidelity colour profiles. v1 offers these entries only (no free-form colour). The user preference stores the entry KEY (e.g. "purple"), never a hex.

order.notes: Swatch display order in the "Background colour" submenu.

background.notes: Observed writing default (#A855F7). Contrast with foreground 4.81:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for purple; 4.81:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Observed grammar default (#007AFF); observed in inactive captures, so CANDIDATE. Contrast with foreground 4.73:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for blue; 4.73:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Design-system palette entry. Contrast with foreground 5.17:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for indigo; 5.17:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Design-system palette entry (dark green). Contrast with foreground 5.48:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for green; 5.48:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Design-system palette entry. Contrast with foreground 15.99:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for lime; 15.99:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Design-system palette entry (near-black). Contrast with foreground 19.0:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for ink; 19.0:1 on the background (AA body text).

background.notes: Design-system palette entry. The card MUST also carry shadow.hairline (white on the page is 1.05:1). Contrast with foreground 19.0:1.

foreground.notes: Paired foreground for white; 19.0:1 on the background (AA body text).
